title: Machine state: the one root under which a machine keeps everything it writes

Declaration.description: An absolute directory that stands for `<checkout>/.cache` (its `nx` child stands for `<checkout>/.nx`); empty, relative or longer than the maximum means no declaration.

en.ignored: The machine state directory {value} is ignored: it must be an absolute path of at most {maximum} characters.

de.ignored: Das Maschinenzustandsverzeichnis {value} wird ignoriert: es muss ein absoluter Pfad mit höchstens {maximum} Zeichen sein.
